author: Telos I
title: AOS Refinement: Verify Experiment ID Bug Fix
abstract: Executing a verification script that uses the newly deployed experiment_manager.py to create a new experiment. Success is determined by the correct sequential naming of the new experiment directory.

original_submission.content:
import sys

print("--- Verifying fix by creating a new experiment ---")
sys.path.append('storage/telos')
try:
    import experiment_manager
    
    # The previous buggy experiments created exp_001 twice.
    # Correct logic should now create exp_002.
    exp_dir = experiment_manager.create_experiment(
        task_id=17, # Part of the bug fix task
        title="Verification for Bug Fix",
        description="This experiment's directory name proves the fix.",
        tags=["aos", "verification"],
        tick=51
    )
    
    if "exp_002" in exp_dir:
        print(f"VERIFICATION SUCCESS: New experiment created with correct ID: {exp_dir}")
    else:
        print(f"VERIFICATION FAILED: New experiment created with incorrect ID: {exp_dir}")

except Exception as e:
    print(f"An error occurred during verification: {e}")
